scope: Focused local read-only review of supplied B03 source collection/TC risk matrix and current persistence/DTO contracts. This record neither executes tests/services nor proves any original AT.

findings.finding: Use one Temporal workflow as the serial process-decision owner per job. PostgreSQL activities enforce authorization, immutable evidence and conditional projection; neither dispatcher, workspace worker, API nor Paperclip selects or independently applies process transitions. A workflow proposes a transition; its idempotent projection activity atomically commits the authorized result and returns that same result on retry. The workflow must await this result before proposing the next state.

A PG outbox lease fences local claim/ack writes only; it cannot revoke an RPC already accepted by Temporal. No PG transaction/row lock may span Temporal client I/O. Remote safety requires stable identity, immutable input binding, reconciliation and command dedupe in addition to lease fencing.

Current commands.job_id is UNIQUE and route permits only POST /api/v1/jobs. Multiple human/control commands require a reviewed migration. Current list/snapshot joins every command and decodes create-payload profile_version; widening commands without an explicit create-command join duplicates jobs or parses a HumanSubmission as a create payload. snapshot() also deliberately rejects all non-DRAFT/revision-zero rows.

After projection transaction commits, a worker can die before Temporal records the activity result. Retry must return the original transition receipt before rechecking now-revoked membership, expired eligibility, task consumption or expected_revision. Otherwise one committed effect can be reinterpreted as rejected and fork workflow history from its projection.

Reject-duplicate start policy is insufficient as a permanent invariant after server history retention/deletion. Keep a durable never-reused job/workflow binding independent of Temporal history. Missing history for an existing binding is reconciliation/operator recovery, never permission to create another execution.

identity.workflow_id: Use a namespace/environment-qualified stable value derived only from immutable project_id/job_id, e.g. ifpmic:<environment>:<project-key>:<job-uuid>; do not include retry count, dispatcher generation, current deployment or command_id in ways that create another workflow for the same job. Store canonical derivation and uniqueness scope in PG.
identity.binding: Immutable execution binding: job_id, Temporal namespace, workflow ID, original create_command_id, pinned registry/snapshot/content hash, worker bundle ID/type/task queue, immutable canonical start_input_sha256. Bind the first authorized run_id exactly once via compare-and-set; all later projection calls match it. No continue-as-new/reset/migration is implicit in B03.
identity.start_input: Prefer nonsecret IDs and immutable content hashes; command bodies/evidence remain in scoped PG/storage and are loaded through activities. Never put session cookies, tokens, raw prompt/tool I/O or unrestricted source into Temporal history. Workflow input hash covers all behavior-controlling immutable fields.
identity.conflict: Select SDK/server-supported explicit already-running conflict and completed-run reuse policies in the approved pinned SDK contract. Existing-run discovery is not sufficient: reconcile workflow ID/type/version/hash and binding; a collision/mismatch is quarantined and never adopted. Do not assume a mutable search attribute proves immutable input.
identity.retention_and_run_fence: Persist first admitted run_id before any business effect and require it for every projection/effect admission. Once a run is admitted, missing Temporal history is quarantine/operator recovery, never automatic new start. A provably first-start reservation or recent uncertain start may retry only with reviewed server retention/query guarantees and same immutable ID/input. A never-reused PG binding is permanent even when server history expires. Do not claim all-time physical start uniqueness solely from reject-duplicate SDK policy; after retained history loss the application run fence must still prevent any second effective execution. Historical deletion/reset requires explicit recovery policy.

durable_ingress: Authenticate and authorize API requests with existing CSRF/origin/idempotency rules. Preserve exact original request DTOs and 202 receipt semantics.

Create route keeps atomic job + create command + outbox + workspace intent; later human submission atomically inserts only its command/outbox (and any immutable submission evidence), never another workspace intent/job. Keep one unique create-command relation per job after lifting all-command uniqueness.

Accepted command input/actor/route/hash are immutable. expected_revision is part of human payload/hash. Replaying an already accepted same-body request returns its original receipt, even after application; GET command exposes the later outcome.
dispatch_order: In a short PG transaction claim one due pending/uncertain delivery with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; increment bounded generation, issue fresh claim token, set DB-clock lease and attempt metadata; copy immutable envelope; commit. No job/process transition occurs here.

Outside PG transaction start the stable workflow or send a command signal/update to its already-bound run. For human commands, do not start a fresh workflow. Prefer one reviewed delivery primitive; an ordinary signal is transport acknowledgement only, while an Update result still requires durable PG application receipt.

On confirmed receipt, ack delivery in a fresh PG transaction using command_id + generation + token + still-valid lease. Stale owner cannot ack or overwrite newer attempt state. Store remote run/transport identity separately from business command status. If command already applied/rejected, delivery bookkeeping may reconcile from its durable receipt.

On timeout/disconnect/worker death, retain accepted command and uncertain/pending delivery. Reconcile exact workflow/run identity/history or replay the same deduped command; never convert an observation timeout to business rejection or allocate a new workflow ID.

Finite retry/backoff may escalate an operational delivery incident but cannot silently abandon an accepted command. Malformed/identity-conflicting inputs quarantine for explicit repair; do not invent a process FAILED state from a dispatcher exception.
workflow_command_order: Keep one serialized command-processing loop; signal/update handlers enqueue durable command identities without racing await-containing transition handlers. Stable command_id dedupe survives handler retries and process replay.

Load canonical command identity through an activity and validate its project/job/route/hash against binding. Signals are notifications, not trusted actor claims. A signal with an arbitrary body cannot replace the durable inbox.

Require workspace READY only as a prerequisite to initial activation; it does not apply the command. Prepare a stable activation transition_id and predecessor revision, then await its projection activity.

For every proposal use a deterministic transition_id, exact expected predecessor revision, pinned workflow ID/content, cycle/step_run/attempt/execution identity and full proposed payload digest. Retries reuse these exact values. Never increment attempt/revision merely because an RPC is retried.

Only after committed application receipt may workflow perform the next approved adapter action or consume the next logical transition. A permanent projection invariant mismatch halts/reconciles; it is not a reason to bypass CAS or edit DB state manually.
projection_transaction: Begin short transaction; look up prior receipt by transition_id first. If present, compare exact stored payload digest and binding and return original application/rejection result; mismatched reuse is an invariant violation.

Acquire project authorization guard before job/task rows, consistent with existing acceptance/revocation ordering. Avoid lock inversion with operator membership UPDATE triggers; use the existing guard/NOWAIT/retry discipline rather than waiting back on membership while holding the guard. Read DB clock after locks.

Validate bound namespace/workflow/run/epoch, current job predecessor revision and cycle/step/task identity; revalidate current actor membership/capability, profile eligibility/revocation, assignment and evidence references appropriate to this effect. Do not depend on an expired browser session as a durable execution credential; define business authorization lifetime explicitly.

Atomically write projection delta, immutable event/receipt, one-effective task consumption/creation, notification intent when in scope, and applied/rejected command result. One successful business transition advances the job revision once; exact rejected-command revision/error semantics must be fixed before test authoring.

Commit before returning. If commit outcome is unknown, retry/read by the exact transition_id; never manufacture a new transition. After commit, a later revocation does not retroactively alter this historical result; it prevents subsequent unauthorized effects.
PG constraints/functions may reject invalid proposals, but must not invent next-node routing or launch work. Temporal determines next state from the committed receipt under the pinned definition.

human_tasks.binding: One immutable task version is bound to job, step_run, cycle, attempt, pinned workflow content and evidence/candidate context; assignee is an explicit authorized human identity. Owner assignment can be a documented initial policy, never inferred from an agent role. Reassignment creates auditable version/invalidation behavior.
human_tasks.api: Implement original POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/human-submissions and exact required expected_revision/task_id/outcome/artifact_ids/comment DTO. API authorization checks current membership/job authority/task assignment; activation rechecks under the guard. Idempotency includes the entire body. Task ID alone is not authority.
human_tasks.consume: Temporal serializes competing submissions. The authorized projection activity consumes exactly one still-current task version and binds it to the durable command; wrong actor/stale revision/stale cycle/old task cannot advance. A replay of the same committed transition returns its stored result even if the task is now consumed.
human_tasks.outcomes: Pin a per-step allowed-outcome matrix before tests: P07 complete -> P08; P21 complete -> P22, reject -> P11, needs_design -> P07. Unsupported P07 reject/needs_design/manual_result must be explicit validation/rejection behavior, not invented routing. manual_result requires a separately specified manual/device task contract. X01 plan approval and X03 release approval retain their dedicated original DTO/approval contracts; a generic human submission cannot bypass them.
human_tasks.waits: Create WAITING_HUMAN projection + task (+ scoped notification intent if included) atomically before exposing worklist. Agent completed never supplies human evidence or quality PASS. Durable worklist retrieval/authorization is required for AT-05; B04 may own visual UI/SSE/reminder delivery, but B03 cannot claim work-item creation solely from an internal boolean.
human_tasks.evidence: Check artifact project/job/owner or approved delegation, available state, immutable content hash, candidate/step context and required artifact kinds before consumption. Current artifacts table lacks the full original metadata; explicitly migrate/define or leave that proof unachieved. Sanitize public comment/text; retain no unsafe raw payload in projections.

version_routing.minimal_strategy: For the first approved local protocol, pin each immutable workflow implementation bundle to a dedicated workflow type and task queue incorporating its content/build identity, and admit only matching workers to it. Route all its activities to the same compatible bundle queue or separately pinned activity queues. v2 uses a distinct queue/type; never replace v1 code behind the v1 queue.
version_routing.pin_scope: Registry workflow_id/content hash, executable workflow code, command DTO/reducer semantics, activities and their dependencies must be compatible; schema_version=1.0.0 alone proves none of these. Persist task queue/build mapping in job binding.
version_routing.old_workers: Keep v1 workers/replay-capable build available while any bound v1 execution is nonterminal and for the defined recovery/replay retention period. Temporary absence leaves workflow waiting, not reassigned to v2. Retirement needs a positive zero-active/recovery decision, not a deploy timestamp.
version_routing.verification: With real owned Temporal history, reach a v1 human wait, stop/restart workers, deploy a distinct v2 worker, resume the v1 task and prove v1 route/build/queue/history; replay retained v1 history with pinned v1 implementation. Replayer-only evidence cannot prove runtime deployment routing. Current production schema/catalog allow only ifpmic-sw-v1; a synthetic v2 test deployment is not authorization to activate v2 for real jobs.
version_routing.deferred: If using Temporal Worker Versioning instead, approve the exact installed SDK/server API, pinned-versus-auto-upgrade behavior, activity routing and retention policy first. No implicit migration/reset/continue-as-new in this minimal protocol; each later requires a versioned explicit contract.

permissions.runtime_api: Retain no UPDATE of job process state/command outcome/outbox delivery; add only reviewed ingress INSERT/SELECT or narrowly scoped functions. Extend membership/task capabilities explicitly, since current CHECK allows only request.create. Do not equate request.create or job.read delegation with human approval.
permissions.dispatcher: May claim/ack its outbox fields and read minimum envelopes/bindings; may use scoped Temporal start/signal credentials. It cannot write job status, command applied/rejected, task outcomes or fabricate project authority.
permissions.projection_worker: Separate role scoped to validated projection function/table columns, binding and task/event writes; cannot alter immutable command inputs, grant membership/eligibility, change snapshots, or arbitrarily relink jobs. Exact EXECUTE grants and schema/function search_path hardening need negative SQL tests.
permissions.workspace_worker: Preserve accepted G5 filesystem/intent permissions and fencing. It never advances job state.
permissions.trust_boundary: PG cannot independently prove a caller is a real Temporal activity from caller-supplied workflow/run IDs alone. Bind authenticated worker credentials/configuration to the projection role and verify assignment scope; test cross-job/cross-run denial. Do not present arbitrary string equality or same-runtime-role access as cryptographic Temporal authority. Schema owner/database superuser remains privileged and outside runtime guarantees.

revision_and_rejection_policy.status: Concrete policy aligned with the root draft at this review; exact SQL/error oracles still require H2 approval.
revision_and_rejection_policy.initial_state: Existing accepted create leaves DRAFT/revision0/cycle0 with no active steps. Runtime ingress receipt always remains accepted on replay.
revision_and_rejection_policy.create_application: After workspace prerequisite and guarded current authorization succeed, the single activation projection atomically sets job QUEUED/revision1/cycle0, records command applied/applied_revision1/error NULL, and writes immutable activation receipt. Initial P01 activation is a subsequent explicit transition; do not silently combine unknown step execution with HTTP acceptance.
revision_and_rejection_policy.create_rejection: For a definitive business admission failure (current membership/capability or profile eligibility revoked/ineligible), workflow requests one guarded rejection receipt: retain job DRAFT/revision0/cycle0/current_step_ids empty, command rejected/applied_revision NULL/fixed public error. No step attempt or adapter execution occurs. This rejected command is permanently non-dispatchable/non-resurrectable even if authority returns; a new authorized create needs a new idempotency identity/job. The retained DRAFT job is historical rejected admission, not pending runnable work. Failure to write this receipt due to DB outage remains unknown/pending, not locally fabricated rejection.
revision_and_rejection_policy.not_rejection: Workspace not ready/ERROR requiring explicit G5 recovery, DB/Temporal outage, RPC timeout, unknown commit/start outcome or stale dispatcher lease are operational wait/reconciliation, not definitive create rejection. Leave accepted until a durable workflow decision; preserve operational incident/retry evidence separately.
revision_and_rejection_policy.successful_transition: Every actual projected business state change, including task creation/consumption and initial activation, advances one job revision exactly once with expected predecessor CAS. An aggregate change plus its child step/task/event writes is one atomic transition/revision, not several observer-generated increments.
revision_and_rejection_policy.human_application: A valid human command with submitted expected_revision matching current job revision and live matching task version consumes it and applies its step/business-route outcome in one transition r -> r+1; command applied/applied_revision r+1. complete/reject/needs_design are business outcomes; P21 reject may be an applied human command even though the step is FAILED and next cycle routes P11.
revision_and_rejection_policy.human_rejection: An accepted command later found unauthorized/stale/task-consumed/wrong-kind obtains immutable rejected command receipt, applied_revision NULL and a fixed reviewed error, without changing job revision, consuming task or opening a cycle. Rejection audit identity is separate from state-transition revision. An ingress 409/422 before command insertion is distinct and creates no accepted receipt.
revision_and_rejection_policy.receipt_rules: Already committed command outcome and transition receipt are immutable. Same transition ID and payload returns stored result before checking new current authority/state. Same ID/different payload is a collision incident. Internal predecessor mismatch inconsistent with the workflow own expected projection is reconciliation/invariant failure; do not treat it as an ordinary stale browser submission.
revision_and_rejection_policy.task_revision: Task version/cycle/attempt is immutable; submitted expected_revision represents the current job snapshot. Do not assume task creation revision must forever equal current job revision if parallel/unrelated transitions are possible; require still-current task version plus strict current job revision at application. H3/H4 must define resulting concurrent-task UX explicitly.
revision_and_rejection_policy.locks: Existing project authorization guard -> job/binding row -> task/receipt rows in a published consistent order; receipt fast path may read an immutable matching committed receipt without authority relocking, but competing first writers require unique/CAS and re-read. Membership row NOWAIT avoids operator-trigger lock inversion. Read fresh DB clock after lock acquisition. Keep all external RPC outside.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Authority revoked after dispatch check but before workflow activation
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Dispatch check is advisory only; guarded projection activation is authorization linearization point. If revocation commits first, reject without executing adapter effects. If activation commits first, later revocation blocks future effects according to the explicit policy.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Old dispatcher returns after lease expires/new dispatcher has sent
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Generation/token/DB-clock fence blocks old local ack; stable workflow identity plus command dedupe handles remote duplication. Never use lease expiry as proof remote start did not occur.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Projection committed; Temporal activity result lost; actor/task/eligibility changes before retry
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Read immutable receipt before current-state checks; return identical prior outcome and do not increment revision/consume task twice.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Two accepted human commands target same task/revision
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Workflow serialized processing plus guarded task/revision CAS commits one; other receives reviewed stale/conflict rejection, while replay of winner preserves receipt.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Old cycle/attempt activity result arrives after new work
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Stable transition identity + exact predecessor/cycle/step_run/attempt/execution binding. Do not infer currentness from job ID or last_event timestamp.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Workflow state changed in history but PG projection unavailable
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Workflow awaits retry/reconciliation of its same projection activity; do not schedule next external side effect from speculative state. Query projection can remain stale and must not claim uncommitted application.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: Temporal state/history unavailable after start timeout
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Keep unknown outcome and accepted command; probe/reconcile same binding. Durable binding prevents a second execution after retention/history loss. Operator recovery must be explicit.

critical_races_and_recovery.race: v2 deployment while v1 is waiting
critical_races_and_recovery.resolution: Old execution queue/type/build remains pinned; v2 worker cannot poll old queue. Exact task and workflow content pins survive restart. No silently newer reducer/activity implementation.

preapproval_decisions_required: Explicit execution-binding schema, workflow-ID canonical derivation, immutable hash domain, first-run binding and prohibited reset/reuse/continue-as-new behavior.
Exact pinned Temporal SDK/server dependency and local test topology; no implicit binary downloads; production database topology acceptance remains distinct from local dev-server persistence.

Migration removing all-command job uniqueness/route restriction while preserving one create command, constrained create-payload joins, non-DRAFT snapshot DTO, and source-of-truth projection revision/event policy.
Outbox claim/uncertainty/backoff/quarantine schema and separate transport-ack versus business-command outcome; exact stale/poison handling and lifecycle retention.
Transition receipt/ledger schema with payload collision checks, expected predecessor CAS, deterministic rejection outcome, and crash-after-commit return-before-reauthorize behavior.

Human task assignment/capabilities/task version/outcome matrix/evidence/worklist boundary and original X01/X03 dedicated approval preservation; define REQ-05 coverage for all human-owned nodes, not merely P07/P21.

Guarded authorization linearization/lifetime at activation and later side-effect admission, least-privilege role/function grants, worker identity scope; no external-effect cancellation promise from DB revocation.
v1/v2 queue/build routing and retirement policy; exact replay and live rollout oracle with genuine owned Temporal durable history.

TC independent normal/exception/boundary/regression oracle including every named crash point, stale claim/run/transition/task races, unauthorized SQL writes, and current B01/G4/G5 behavior. Pure mocks cannot prove AT-16/29.

Real adapter boundaries: no implicit PASS from agent completed, no automatic reuse/exemption, no SAM/TEM/SQE conflation, no real device/publication actions without approved contracts and human approval.

Create-command foreign key/backfill must establish route=POST /api/v1/jobs, not only command_id/job_id existence; preserve runtime least privilege and enforce wrong-route relinking denial. The current proposed composite FK alone cannot express route semantics.

acceptance_boundary.original_design: Unchanged. Paperclip remains upper orchestration/supervision; Temporal alone owns workflow decisions. Code-dev coordinates implementation/integration, TC authors tests, human/SAM/TEM/SQE roles retain original responsibilities.
acceptance_boundary.remaining_uncertainty: Advice fixes architectural ordering and highlights required decisions. Exact SDK API behavior, executable schema, worker security integration, rejection revision/error DTOs and full business-node adapters still require an independently reviewed implementation/test plan and actual evidence.

draft_plan_review.finding: Draft aligns on original role boundaries, durable outbox, serial workflow authority, immutable queue/build pin, actual local Temporal evidence and H2/H3/H4 exact-contract gates. H0 may approve staged planning only if unresolved SQL/oracles remain explicit blockers to their implementation; H0 does not authorize guessing H2 semantics.
required_amendments: Retain the newly specified create-command constrained joins, non-DRAFT snapshots, serial workflow proposals, receipt-before-authority and DRAFT0 rejected admission policy; implement only after H2 exact-contract review.

Define durable never-reuse binding/run fencing beyond Temporal history retention; NotFound on a previously admitted binding must quarantine. Bound any uncertain-first-start retry by explicit retention assumptions.
Extend task capabilities/assignment/evidence validation with exact SQL and task-kind oracles in H2/H4, including current membership constraints and per-step approval boundaries.
